content: Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

The Saber Sneakers are available for $86. They come in various colors including Serene, Tiffany, Dirty Blue, Sand, Light Green, Light Blue, Olive, Light Brown, Lilac, Khaki, Turquoise, Orange, Black, and Dark Blue. Sizes available range from 41 to 48.
